entries.zh: 做得体面漂亮；行事大方得体
entries.en: to do something in a fine, gallant manner; to carry it off handsomely
entries.notes: 西语 lo galano（体面、漂亮）为释义主轴，但汉字栏「托俗」与音写 toy siog dam uan（四音节对二字）均不相合，语义未能定夺。

entries.en: to do separately; to do apart from the rest

entries.zh: 理顺心安；把事情料理顺当，心里安定
entries.en: to set matters in order so that the mind is at ease
entries.notes: 西语栏「la justo, quierasse el cotato」语句残乱，释义主要依汉字栏「理顺心安」与音写 li fun sim an 定。

entries.en: to do wrong; to do a wicked turn
entries.notes: 西语 hacer malhecho 明指做恶，然汉字栏作「圡做」、音写作 thö chô，与西语不合，疑原件笔误。

entries.en: to make a boundary; to mark off a border

entries.zh: 施恩于人；推恩（把好处给予别人）
entries.en: to do good to another; to extend grace to others
to make wax candles (straining and pouring the wax)
entries.notes: 西语 candelas de ceria（蜡制蜡烛）与汉字栏「滤蜡烛」相合，唯「蜡」字音写作 ta，与常音不谐。

entries.en: to make (wax) candles
to do something for the time being; to make do with borrowed means

entries.zh: 暂时；权时（临时变通行事）
entries.en: to do something temporarily; to make shift for the present

entries.zh: 权宜行事；暂且借用应付
entries.en: to act by expedient; to make shift with what is borrowed
entries.notes: 汉字栏「将权」非常语，音写 chiàng cuān 与之勉强对应，释义依西语 hacer de prestado 推断。

entries.zh: 反其道而行；倒着来，违背旧规
entries.en: to do the opposite; to go against the customary way
entries.notes: 西语 al reue 当为 al revés（倒反、反着来），后半「delos lemandan」未能解，姑依前半与汉字栏「故越」定。

entries.zh: 创局；开设新局（铺面、作坊或机构）
entries.en: to set up a new establishment; to found a new concern or office
entries.notes: 西语栏「egano otroza」残乱难读，释义依汉字栏「创局」与音写 chòng quiôg 定。

entries.en: to create; to make anew

entries.zh: 绵绵做；不停歇地做，持续地做
entries.en: to keep doing without cease; to do continuously
entries.notes: 西语 sin cazar 当读作 sin cesar（不停歇），与「绵绵做」正合。

entries.en: to farm; to sow a crop, to work the fields
to till the fields

entries.zh: 出于真心；存心而为（由衷而做）
entries.en: to do from the heart; to do sincerely
entries.notes: 汉字栏「为心」作存心、用心解，配西语 de coraçon（由衷）定为此义。

entries.zh: 任意而行；随自己的意思做
entries.en: to act according to one's own will
entries.notes: 汉字栏有 [疑:丄/之]，音写仅 hūa hūang 两音节对三字，西语栏亦残乱，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to make a breeze; to fan
to fan; to ply a fan
to fan; to make air with a fan
entries.notes: 汉字栏「打方」与音写 pa pūy 对应不明，然西语与前后条同指搧风，姑依此解。

entries.en: to fan; to wave a fan
entries.notes: 汉字栏首字有 [疑:撼/掩]，音写 iēn sy 与二字均不密合，释义依西语搧风之义定。

entries.en: to do something filthy or wicked
entries.notes: 汉字栏「蛆」有 [疑:蛆/猝]，「秽蛆动」语意未安，释义依西语 cosa sucia, mala 定。
